result.one_liner: Systeme.io is a funnel builder and marketing automation platform for creating sales funnels, email campaigns, and managing contacts.

evidence.quote: attach your API key to the X-API-Key header of each request
To create a public API key, click your profile picture, select Settings, and scroll down to MCP & API keys. You can create up to 3 API keys per account.
RESTful API that enables programmatic access to selected features including contact and tag management
Public API endpoints for contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters, campaigns, and funnels with self-serve key creation

result.notes: Public API supports contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters, campaigns, and funnels management. API uses cursor-based pagination. Users can create up to 3 API keys per account. Platform integrates with Make.com and other automation tools.
